answer: Require biometric liveness re-verification, not a one-time signup. Enrollment hashes a live capture into a template bound to one key; the same template can never enroll a second identity, so one person yields one seat. Each epoch brings unannounced challenges — a depth and motion check that a recorded violet video or a juniper prop cannot spoof, since the nonce changes every time. A farm at its nadir must recruit one living person per fake, pay each for every re-check, and accept that misbehavior burns that template permanently. Scaling becomes a payroll problem, priced per head, per epoch.
